FN-N457J88-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 43
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Bill Lamb
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/23/2024
House Bill 43 as introduced would exempt High Socks for Hope, Incorporated from paying
state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes, which will decrease receipts to the
following funds by the estimated annual amounts, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, based on
information provided by the entity:
Education Trust Fund ($ 990)
County Funds ($740)
Municipal Funds ($1,230)
Total ($2,960)
Page 1

FN-N457J88-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 43
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Bill Lamb
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/28/2024
House Bill 43 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by approximately $990 annually,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, based on information provided by the entity, by exempting
High Socks for Hope, Incorporated from paying state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the
estimated annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, based on information
provided by the entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local
sales and use tax, pursuant to this bill:
County Funds ($740)
Municipal Funds ($1,230)
